annotations.title: Check whether a crawler gets a usable page list

description: Use this when someone wants their XML sitemap checked. Reports whether a site's sitemap is reachable, parses, is declared in robots.txt, and is free of cross-host entries a crawler discards. A handful of fetches, no AI.

url.description: The site or page URL to check. A bare domain like example.com is fine.
